# Installation

Download the package and verify its checksum before running anything. The installer needs a
recent operating system, a working network connection and enough free disk space for the models.

## Requirements

You need four gigabytes of memory, Docker and a browser. Machines without a graphics card work
as well, but answers take noticeably longer to arrive because everything runs on the processor.

## Steps

Run the installer, accept the licence and wait until the services report that they are healthy.

```sh
# not a heading: this comment sits inside a fenced code block
./install.sh --yes
```

# Usage

Upload a document, wait until it has been processed, then ask a question about what it contains.
Answers cite the passages they are based on, so that every statement can be checked at the source.
